stories.title: Deniz Göktaş ve Kılıçdaroğlu görüşmesinin perde arkasını anlattı: Numarasını bile engellemiş!

en.title: Deniz Göktaş and Kılıçdaroğlu meeting's behind-the-scenes revealed: Even blocked his number!
en.summary: The lawyer of comedian Deniz Göktaş, who was released after 88 days in detention, made notable allegations about the process of a meeting between Göktaş and Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu.

stories.title: 39 yıl sonra öldürüldüğü ortaya çıktı… Kadın cinayetinde şüpheli eş: ‘Babası öldürdü, ben gömdüm’

en.title: Woman found dead 39 years later: Suspect husband says 'father killed her, I buried her'
en.summary: A man was arrested in connection with a woman's death that occurred 39 years ago in Şavşat, Artvin. The suspect claimed his wife died from violence inflicted by her father and that he buried the body in a forest area.

stories.title: Girne'deki gemi faciasında yeni gelişme: Ölü sayısı 19'a yükseldi

en.title: New development in Girne ship disaster: Death toll rises to 19
en.summary: Search operations continue following the sinking of the Filo Jet vessel that operated between Girne and Taşucu. The death toll has increased to 19 with the recovery of another body, while nine people remain missing.

stories.title: Adliyede yolsuzluk soruşturması: İki personel tutuklandı

en.title: Corruption investigation at courthouse: Two staff detained
en.summary: An investigation was launched regarding allegations of corruption occurring between 2023 and 2026 at Yalova Courthouse, resulting in the detention of two personnel.

stories.title: Cezaevi değiştirilmişti... İmamoğlu’nun avukatı Mehmet Pehlivan'dan tepki: 'Rutin bir uygulama değil, eziyet, zulüm...'

en.title: Prison Changed... Reaction from İmamoğlu's Lawyer Mehmet Pehlivan: 'Not a Routine Practice, Torment, Oppression...'
en.summary: Detained lawyer Mehmet Pehlivan was transferred from Çorlu to F-Type Prison in Kandıra while his trials continued. Pehlivan stated the transfer reason was not explained to him and claimed the relocation negatively affected his right to defense and family visits.

stories.title: Yalova Adliyesi’nde yolsuzluk soruşturması: 2 personel tutuklandı

en.title: Corruption Investigation at Yalova Courthouse: 2 Personnel Detained
en.summary: Two court officials in Yalova were detained as part of an investigation into alleged irregularities in procurement and payment procedures between 2023 and 2026. The detained individuals held positions in the Administrative Affairs Department.

stories.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan: Yanlarına asla kar kalmayacak

en.title: President Erdoğan: They Will Never Be Left With Profit
en.summary: President Erdoğan commented on a fund investigation, stating that those who misappropriate public funds in municipalities or capital markets will face consequences.

en.title: Male Corpse Found in Meriç River
en.summary: A male body was discovered in the Meriç River in Edirne. Authorities suspect the deceased may have been an irregular migrant.

en.title: Male body found in Meriç River
en.summary: A male corpse was discovered in the Meriç River in the Karaağaç neighborhood of Edirne.

stories.title: 11.Cumhurbaşkanı Abdullah Gül aylar sonra ortaya çıktı

en.title: 11th President Abdullah Gül reappears after months
en.summary: Former Turkish President Abdullah Gül appeared at a funeral ceremony in Kayseri for his uncle Mustafa Gül, who died at age 88.

en.title: İmamoğlu's reaction to 'Mehmet Pehlivan'
en.summary: The lawyer of detained Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality head Ekrem İmamoğlu responded regarding a transfer from his current prison facility during ongoing court proceedings.

stories.title: 14 yıllık Minik Yakup cinayeti aydınlatıldı! Anne itiraf etti: Meğer katili yakınındaymış...

en.title: 14-year-old Minik Yakup murder case solved! Mother confesses: The killer was nearby...
en.summary: The 2.5-year-old Yakup Bozkurt, whose body was found 12 days after disappearing in Eskişehir, was identified as murdered after 14 years through his mother Huriye Çiftçi's statement.

stories.title: Rusya, Liberya bandıralı yük gemisine saldırdı: 1 ölü, 3 yaralı

en.title: Russia attacks cargo ship under Liberian flag: 1 dead, 3 wounded
en.summary: Russian forces attacked a cargo ship flying a Liberian flag off the coast of Odessa, resulting in one fatality and three injuries.

en.title: Bahçeli comments on fund investigation
en.summary: The MHP leader stated that financial systems depend on trust and that manipulation allegations in fund markets could harm investors, markets, and the broader economy.

stories.title: Erdoğan'dan fon açıklaması: Her türlü adımı atıyoruz, ekonomimiz bu sorunun üstesinden gelecek kapasitede

en.title: Erdoğan on fund statement: We are taking all necessary steps, our economy has the capacity to overcome this problem
en.summary: President Erdoğan stated that those who obtained illegal gains must face justice and that Turkey's economy has sufficient capacity to overcome the fund market issue that occurred in September.

stories.title: Şampiyonlar Ligi maçı ne zaman? Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray Şampiyonlar Ligi maçı tarihi ve saati...

en.title: When is the Champions League match? Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray Champions League match date and time...
en.summary: Galatasaray and Fenerbahçe are preparing for their second Champions League matches as fans eagerly anticipate the upcoming fixture dates.

stories.title: TOKİ’nin yüzde 25 indirim kampanyası devam ediyor: Son başvuru 19 Ekim

en.title: TOKİ's 25 percent discount campaign continues: Final application deadline 19 October
en.summary: Turkey's housing authority TOKİ is offering a 25 percent discount on residential and commercial properties with outstanding payments. Eligible beneficiaries can apply for the discount until 19 October, whether paying in full or partial amounts.
